item.title: Hegseth Impeachment Push, Citibank Shooting Hero, Wall Street Selloff: AM Update 11/6 (Ad-Free)
item.description:
Secretary of War Pete Hegseth faces a growing bipartisan impeachment threat as President Trump reportedly considers replacing him following Republicans' devastating midterm losses. A Marine veteran working as a security guard fatally shoots a gunman who killed a Citibank employee at an office complex near Tampa, Florida, as investigators link the attack to a $2,500 debt. Indiana executes a man convicted of murdering two children, while Florida and Alabama prepare to carry out two additional executions on the same day amid renewed scrutiny of lethal injection procedures. Wall Street suffers a massive selloff that wipes out its post-election gains, with the Nasdaq plunging 5.5 percent as investors grow concerned about restrictions on data center development and the future of the AI boom.
